entries.title: Psalms 143:1
segments:
PSALM CLXIII. 
 
  David complains and prays for pardon and help, ver. 1-12.   A psalm of David.

entries.title: Psalms 143:2
segments: V. 2. Justified-Upon terms of strict justice.

entries.title: Psalms 143:3
segments: V. 3. For-This is not a reason of what he last said, but an argument to enforce his petition delivered, ver.
. Soul-My life; nothing less will satisfy him.  Dead-I am in as hopeless a condition in the eye of man, as those that have lain long in the grave.

entries.title: Psalms 143:5
segments: V. 5. The days-What thou hast done for thy servants in former times.
